plain: Baby steps, updated as they happen. Each line is one concrete thing being done right now; done lines stay for the day so you can see the trail.

steps.text: Film-window detector rewritten around motion and brightness; matches the hand-found answer on the snow game

Camera-angle labelling does not transfer between games with the hand-tuned feature; two replacements failed
Contact-sheet tool built; 42 takes labelled; layout classifier trained (86% leave-one-out)
Spike-based cut detection: 286 takes against 282 implied by the play list (was 406)
Pairing takes to plays: take alignment on dense camera readings; both games index cleanly and every kick lands on its film
SAM 3 on the M4: 0.16 frames/s sustained (fanless Air), 236 h a game; 3.5 h for the 2,000-frame labelling set
Spike GRD-95: SAM 3D Body fits All-22 players at about 1 s each; 25 of 27 crops good or rough, fitted bodies for everyone
Camera labels were swapped in both games (SIDELINE was the end-zone camera); names, model, tests and charts corrected
Get a 1080p copy of 49ers–Rams: the drive's copy is 576p, and wide-shot players are mostly missed at that size
Owner: spot-check the 86 camera labels Claude added to the clear game (source "claude" in its shot_views file)
Labelling loop built: sampler, SAM 3 teacher, review page, student training (GRD-28 to GRD-31)
SAM 3 teacher: snow game done (2,000 frames, 3.4 h); 49ers–Rams running
Review page tested in Chrome and fixed (boxes were not drawn); ball boxes below 0.4 cut after an eyeball check
Owner: review the snow game's boxes, one key per frame (open review.html in its frames folder on the drive; space enlarges, a click removes a stray box; Export when done)
